players.bio: Andrew Farai Rinomhota (born 21 April 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Reading. Born in England, he plays for the Zimbabwe national team.
Ashqar Zamil Ahmed (born 31 August 2007) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Reading.
Benn David Ward (born 31 October 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Reading.

Boyd Beacroft is a 20-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a defender (centre-back) for Reading F.C. Boyd has played for The Royals’ Under 18s and is currently part of Peter Scott’s U21s set up. He made his First Team debut back in November 2024, away at Cheltenham Town in the Group Stages of the Vertu Trophy.
Charlie William Henry Savage (born 2 May 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Reading. Born in England, he plays for the Wales national team.
Conor Ciaran Masterson (born 8 September 1998) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Reading.
Daniel Kamkam Kyerewaa (born 5 October 2001) is a German professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Reading.

Daniel James Schofield (born 10 April 1980) is an English former footballer and manager who is an assistant coach at Central Coast Mariners. Playing career Huddersfield Town Schofield was signed by Huddersfield Town from Brodsworth Welfare for a fee of £2,000 in 1998.
George Robert Earthy (born 5 September 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or right midfielder for EFL League One club Reading.
Haydon Cameron Roberts (born 10 May 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left back and centre back for EFL League One side Reading.

Jack David Marriott (born 9 September 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League One club Reading. Marriott started his career at Ipswich Town, making his debut at the end of the 2012–13 season. Marriott signed on a two-month loan for Woking of the Conference Premier in November 2013, scoring nine goals in nine matches.

Jack Alexander Stevens (born 2 August 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Reading. Stevens spent time in the youth teams at Chelsea, Barnet, and Reading before turning professional at Oxford United in April 2016. He was loaned out to Cirencester Town, Tamworth, and Port Vale.

Jacob Samuel Brown (born 10 April 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward or wing-back for EFL League One club Reading. Brown started his career with Barnsley, making his professional debut in October 2016. After spending time out on loan at Chesterfield in 2017–18, he broke into the first team at Oakwell, helping them gain promotion to the EFL Championship in 2018–19.
James Tyrrell Reid (born 15 July 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Reading. Born in England, he plays internationally for Northern Ireland.
Abraham Jeriel Richard Dorsett (born 4 May 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Reading. Born in England, he plays for the Montserrat national team.

Joseph Mark Jacobson (born 17 November 1986) is a Welsh professional footballer who most recently played for Wycombe Wanderers. He is the former captain of the Wales U21 team, and is also a former captain of the Cardiff City reserve team.

Joel Dinis Castro Pereira (Portuguese pronunciation: ; born 28 June 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Reading. Pereira joined Manchester United's youth system in 2012. He made three first-team appearances for the club and spent time on loan at Rochdale, Belenenses, Vitória de Setúbal, Kortrijk, Hearts and Huddersfield Town.

Joshua Michael Knight (born 7 September 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back, right-back or defensive midfielder for EFL League One club Reading, on loan from Championship club Portsmouth.

Joshua Dale Stokes (born 29 April 2004) is an English professional football player who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Reading, on loan from EFL Championship club Bristol City.

Kyreece Joshua Lisbie (born 1 December 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays for as a winger or forward for EFL League One club Reading. Lisbie is a product of the Leyton Orient and Watford academies and played his first senior football for Cray Valley Paper Mills. After 2+1⁄2 years as a professional with Brentford B, Lisbie transferred to Colchester United in 2025.

Leam Nathan Richardson (born 19 November 1979) is an English professional football manager and former player, currently managing Reading in EFL League One. During his playing career Richardson played as a defender for Blackburn Rovers, Bolton Wanderers, Notts County, Blackpool and Accrington Stanley. He later held coaching roles at Accrington Stanley and Chesterfield.
Lewis Wing (born 23 June 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Reading.

Liam Scott Fraser (born February 13, 1998) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League One club Reading and the Canada national team. He began his career with Toronto FC, signing as a homegrown player in 2018.

Mikele Benjamin Leigertwood (born 12 November 1982) is a former professional footballer who played as a defensive midfielder. Born in England, he represented the Antigua and Barbuda national team at international level.
Patrick John Lane (born 18 February 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Reading.
Padhraic John O'Connor (born 14 July 1997) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Reading.
Randell Alphonso Williams (born 30 December 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a full-back and winger for EFL League One club Reading.

Robert Anthony Kelly (born 21 December 1964) is an English former footballer and manager. He is currently assistant manager at Reading. He is best known for his spell as manager of Leicester City, as well as being assistant manager at several clubs, he has also been a caretaker manager at Preston North End, Sheffield Wednesday, Nottingham Forest and West Bromwich Albion.

Sean Joseph Patton (born 25 July 2006) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Reading. Previously, Patton has played for Derry City and had loan spells at both Finn Harps and Aldershot Town.
Udoka Favour Godwin-Malife (born 9 May 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Reading F.C.
